correctness.rationale: Fourth-shift quadratic equation gives initial polynomial triple (A0,B0,C0), then rational-polynomial NextABC identities exhibit exact parameter loop S1(t)→S2(t)→S3(t)→S1(t+2), valid for every even integer t>=2. The cited Han–Pedon H-fraction determinant theorem converts nonzero index locations and telescoping a_i products into four residue-class formulas. Cyclotomic denominator (1+z^4)^2 with no cancellation forces least quasiperiod 8. Independent integer Hankel determinants for j=0..12 from 28 recurrence coefficients matched 1,2,0,-2,-3,-4,0,4,5,6,0,-6,-7; this finite test does not certify the parametric identities or H-fraction theorem.
